annotationRationale: The arithmetic mean determines the cases and their equations. Solving linear equations supplies the corresponding values of X.
sourceMethod: Follows the official MAA solution by separating the case where the mean equals X, then bounding the mean and testing 5 and 7. The equation establishing X=4 is shown explicitly.

review.mathCheck: The mean is (20+X)/6. Equality to X forces X=4; otherwise positivity makes the mean at least 3.5, leaving only known values 5 and 7. These give X=10 and 22. All three work, and their sum is 36, choice D.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, independently worded adaptation of MAA AMC 10A Problem 8, page 5. It follows the official mean-equals-X case, positivity bound and remaining means, while explicitly solving and checking each case.
review.annotationCheck: Mean is correctly assessed, with one-variable equation solving as background. The cases exhaust all positive integer values; the repeated 5 creates no additional case.
